title: *Java DB*
in NetBeans
ytTitle: How to set up Java DB (Apache Derby) in NetBeans on Windows
desc:
NetBeans no longer comes with Java DB, so we fetch it ourselves: add Apache Derby 10.17.1.0 to NetBeans and load the tuck shop database. For South African IT pupils and teachers.

In this video:
- Downloading the Derby bin zip from db.apache.org/derby
- Unzipping it to C:\Tools\Derby
- Setting the Java DB properties, starting the server and creating the TuckShop database
- Running the tuck shop script and a SELECT query
- When you need a semicolon - and never in a Java program's SQL

desc:

- Downloading MySQL Installer 8.0.46 from dev.mysql.com/downloads - no account needed
